title: Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing — Accounts per Customer and per Contract
content:
**Clause.** A customer may hold up to 2 open Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing accounts (approved, active or delinquent) at once, one per contract. A contract is financed by one account at most; an account finances exactly one contract, a window contract or a door contract. A contract that already has an open or paid-off financing account is never financed a second time.

## What the clause fixes

| Subject | Rule |
|---|---|
| Open accounts per customer at once | Up to 2; an open account is one whose status is approved, active or delinquent |
| Contracts per account | Exactly one: a window contract or a door contract |
| Accounts per contract | One at most |
| A contract with an open or paid-off account | Never financed a second time |

## Evidence

Whether a contract already has a financing account is read from the company's financing records — the window contract or door contract each account finances, and that account's status — as they stand before a new account is opened.

## Status of an existing account on the same contract

| Existing account on the contract | Contract may be financed again |
|---|---|
| Approved | No |
| Active | No |
| Delinquent | No |
| Paid off | No |

## Hypothetical illustration

A customer holding one active account for a window contract and one approved account for a door contract already holds 2 open accounts. A window contract whose earlier account is paid off cannot be financed again.
